sourceCoverage.rationale: All20 source cues checked against retained timed aid; full authored and generated copy read, corrected map spans mechanism, boundaries, hardware and product with exact source links.

supportingArgument.rationale: Refusal suppression can aid authorized defensive work, but willingness does not prove correct useful results.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Creator claims, primary mechanism evidence, vendor documentation and unexecuted hypotheses remain separated.

counterargument.rationale: Actual TruthfulQA regressions and Qwen/Yi exceptions now bound claims of preserved model capability.

tradeoffs.rationale: Local custody, model quality, compute cost and harness privileges are treated as distinct engineering tradeoffs.

falsifiability.rationale: Same authorized tasks, base versus modified models, false positives, misses and latency form a reversible test.

originalSynthesis.rationale: Evaluate useful findings and authority boundaries rather than treating a lower refusal count as complete quality.

performance.rationale: Capacity and bandwidth documentation are separated from unverified throughput and exact checkpoint behavior.

economics.rationale: Cost and setup friction remain unmeasured; the proposed pilot measures them rather than inventing savings.

threatGovernance.rationale: Disposable repository, allowlisted commands, network limits and no production credentials bound the proposed experiment.

gaps.rationale: Source cues are approximate local machine-transcript aids, not certified exact speech or full independent audiovisual replay.
Model throughput, exact provider entitlement, private runtime synthesis and functional model quality were not independently executed in this review.
Optional related-work links remain editorial suggestions rather than authorized graph edges; stale rationale mentions removed suggestions without adding them back.
